# Source: Martin Vanden Bogaert Desjardins

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Martin Vanden Bogaert Desjardins
- **Artist / culture:** Gérard Edelinck (French, born Flanders, 1640-1707) after Hyacinthe Rigaud (French, 1659-1743)
- **Date:** n.d.
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** engraving
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 111
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/111
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/13bb7117-5115-b409-1dbb-1d9c1d70a5c9/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Fauvism

## Extracted source palette

`#181818, #383828, #585848, #C8C8A8, #D8D8C8, #787868, #989878, #B8A898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C0C`
- `surface`: `#282828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#989878`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#D8D8C8`
- `surface_variant`: `#282828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E4E`
- `error`: `#989878`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.4:1`, surface `13.86:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.86:1`
- Control contrast: `6.61:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
